context: A teacher walks a uni student through an ecology paper
purpose: Teach: うつ病/生息/虚偽/発する/挫折/成り立つ/一角/掲げる

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: この論文は、絶滅危惧種の生息域が縮小している現状を示しているの。
lines.en: This paper shows that the habitat range of endangered species is shrinking.
lines.style: Calm, measured academic tone introducing the paper's main premise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。著者は冒頭で「多様性の保全」という大きな目標を掲げるスタイルですね。
lines.en: I see. At the start, the author takes the approach of setting out a big goal of biodiversity conservation.
lines.style: Engaged student summarizing what he's just read, slightly tentative.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そう。ただし、その主張が成り立つには、データの質が前提になるわ。
lines.en: Right. But for that argument to hold up, the quality of the data is a prerequisite.
lines.style: Gentle pivot to critical thinking, teacherly and probing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 実は第三章で、過去の研究に虚偽の数値が含まれていたと指摘されています。
lines.en: Actually, in chapter three it's pointed out that past studies contained falsified figures.
lines.style: Cautious revelation, lowering voice as if sharing something sensitive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いい着眼点ね。その不正は、業界の一角で長年見過ごされてきた問題なの。
lines.en: Good observation. That misconduct is an issue that's been overlooked in a corner of the field for years.
lines.style: Approving, then sober, contextualizing within the wider discipline.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 研究者たちは強い警告を発する一方で、資金難で挫折した例も多いそうですね。
lines.en: While researchers issue strong warnings, apparently many have given up due to funding shortages.
lines.style: Reflective, connecting structural problems to individual hardship.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ。プレッシャーでうつ病になる若手も少なくないと聞くわ。
lines.en: Yes. I hear it's not uncommon for younger scholars to develop depression from the pressure.
lines.style: Quieter, empathetic, acknowledging the human cost of the field.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 考えさせられます。来週までに、批判的な視点でまとめ直してみます。
lines.en: It really makes me think. I'll try to rewrite my summary from a critical perspective by next week.
lines.style: Resolved and grateful, ending on a determined student note.
